name: mq
description: jq-like markdown processor: query and update markdown by AST nodes

mq.description: jq-like markdown processor: query and update markdown by AST nodes
mq.usage:
mq '.h3' file.md # List all h3 headings
mq '.h3 | select(contains("n128"))' file.md # Filter h3 by content
mq -U 'del(.h3 | select(contains("n157")))' file.md # In-place delete (where supported)
mq -F json '.h3' file.md # Output as JSON
mq -M ~/.config/mq/todo.mq 'todo::section("n103")' file.md # Use module
mq repl # Interactive REPL
mq fmt --check file.mq # Format/validate mq query files
mq --list # List builtin + external subcommands

mq-todo.description: mq with todo module preloaded (-A -L modules -m todo). Operates on markdown todo files (h3 sections, [STATE] nNNN heading format).
mq-todo.usage:
mq-todo 'todo::tasks(self) | section::titles()' file.md # List task titles
mq-todo 'todo::drop(self, "n128")' -o file.md file.md # Drop section by id
mq-todo 'todo::drop_all(self, ["n101","n102"])' -o file.md file.md # Drop multiple
mq-todo 'todo::keep_only(self, ["n103"])' src.md > excerpt.md # Extract subset
mq-todo 'todo::get_task(self, "n103")' file.md # View one section
